runs.text: Xiaomi EV has built a delivery base of real scale, and the key question for 2026 is how growth turns into stable profit. Q2 deliveries rebounded while vehicle ASP and the combined segment gross margin stayed under pressure, so volume, price mix and investment intensity need to be read together. New models open room for growth and also raise demands on supply chain, service and quality management. Later judgments should rest on consecutive quarters of deliveries, gross profit and expense results, while keeping the boundary of the combined EV and AI disclosure.
